svg.title: Substitution and two integrations by parts evaluate the last integral. Increase C to total mass to extend an initially small-u bound. This bounds ⟨x, (e−sH −P0)x⟩, keeping the zero atom separate. Character continuity of translated word pairings gives characteristic- function continuity. Fourier inversion with majorant M|bg| gives continuity for compact smooth momentum tests. Approximate heat multipliers by cutoffs equal to one in radius 2N and supported in 3N; cone support bounds the omitted tail by Me−sN uniformly in character. Heat pairings are thus continuous uniform limits. These arguments supply the heat continuity and shell-to-heat steps used in the removal of exceptional characters. Fubini applies since both measures are finite and the integrands are bounded. The lift retains word measures, locality radius, positive time averaging and spectral cone. Recovery preserves these Fourier/Tonelli integrals and uniform majorants, transporting shell and heat bounds while retaining the zero-energy atom.
